implementation_variants.full_name: Centralized Full-State Physical Model Predictive Control, CUDA batched finite-difference implementation
implementation_variants.why_not_a_new_method: Only the predictor-linearisation backend changes. The control law, plant, horizon N=20, controller step 20 ms, predictor step 2 ms, lambda_internal, differential step, route and the 15000 N / tyre 1.0 / non-negative support gates are unchanged, so this is the same method computed differently, not a new algorithm. Per section 7.1 it must never be reported under a separate method name.
implementation_variants.architecture: centralized full-state diagnostic upper bound, unchanged
implementation_variants.predictor: coupled physical model, unchanged; the finite-difference Jacobian is evaluated on the GPU in float64 instead of across 8 CPU processes
implementation_variants.optimizer: CPU OSQP assembly and solve, unchanged; GPU is used only for the batched rollout and its Jacobian
implementation_variants.message_bytes: not applicable; no network in the diagnostic
implementation_variants.state_input_schema: state 30 + actual steering 4 = 34 augmented state, control 8, unchanged
implementation_variants.hardware: DESKTOP-9IUUGEO / NVIDIA RTX 5080 (compute capability 12.0, CUDA 12.8); one persistent CUDA worker process, CPU parent retains SciPy, OSQP, the event-substep true plant and the nonlinear validation
implementation_variants.adaptation_difference: predictor linearisation moved from 8 CPU processes to one CUDA worker; every outbound IPC array is converted to nested lists and every reply is coerced to exact built-in primitives before pickling
